newsitem.title: USA: FIRST BRANDS SEES SLUGGISH MARKETS IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: FIRST BRANDS SEES SLUGGISH MARKETS IN 1997.

text.p: First Brand Corp said Thursday that the same factors that depressed earnings in the quarter and fiscal year ended June 30 will affect results in the next two quarters, with more normal market conditions returning in the last half of fiscal 1998, which begins in January.

In a statement accompanying fourth quarter earnings. William Stephenson, chief executive, said "Sales and earnings in the fourth quarter were primarily affected by market softness in the domestic plastic wrap and bag market and automotive inventory reductions by a major retailer.
